import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { answer } from '../src/answer.mjs';
import { offset } from '../src/offset.mjs';

try {
  assert.equal(answer + offset, 42, 'Repair assertion: the computed answer must equal 42');
} catch (error) {
  process.exitCode = 1;
  console.error(error.stack);
  if (process.argv.includes('--noisy')) {
    console.log('Fixture progress with no failure details\n'.repeat(2500) + 'Saved stdout tail marker');
    console.error('Routine post-failure cleanup progress\n'.repeat(2500) + 'Saved stderr tail marker');
  }
}
